follow-up time: Average of 4.9 years for offspring (range 0.3-14 years)
outcome: remission rate of disease activity during pregnancy
cohort: This study included 67 pregnant women with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) hospitalized in the Department of Obstetrics, Peking University People's Hospital between January 2007 and September 2021.
finding: Previous miscarriages and ANA positivity were independent risk factors for adverse pregnancy outcomes (APOs) in RA patients, while APOs and low-dose prednisone during pregnancy did not significantly affect offspring health.
